summary: Backend verification after removal of public Premium tier — ALL 10 PYTEST CHECKS PASS. (1) Fresh guest can make exactly 10 /api/ai/tool calls (grammar tool); 11th returns HTTP 429 with detail 'Daily limit reached (10/day). Resets at midnight UTC.' — string contains 'Daily limit' AND '10/day' and contains NEITHER 'Upgrade' NOR 'Premium'. (2) /api/auth/me for the guest after 10 uses correctly returns tool_uses_today=10, tool_uses_limit=10, tool_uses_remaining=0, is_premium=false, is_admin=false. (3) Admin login: server route is POST /api/auth/admin (NOT /api/auth/admin/login as written in request — test falls back); login with himthegreat@gmail.com / aa$fufm2q succeeds, returns user.is_admin=true, is_premium=true. (4) Admin made 12 consecutive /api/ai/tool calls — all 200, /me still shows tool_uses_remaining=null (unlimited). (5) Admin whitelist flow: POST /api/admin/whitelist {email, is_premium:true} → 200; GET /api/admin/whitelist returns the entry with is_premium=true; DELETE cleanup → 200. (6) Vocab regression with options.target_language Telugu/Tamil/Bengali — every meaning_translated contained the correct native Unicode block (U+0C00-U+0C7F / U+0B80-U+0BFF / U+0980-U+09FF). Retry logic still triggers when needed (observed in backend logs). (7) GET /api/pricing returns 404 — endpoint correctly absent.

minor.issue: Request spec mentioned POST /api/auth/admin/login, but server exposes POST /api/auth/admin. Frontend (settings.tsx / login.tsx) and existing tests already use /api/auth/admin so it is consistent — only the review request text was off. No code change needed.

critical_code_review_comments: FREE_TOOL_DAILY_LIMIT correctly raised to 10 (server.py:34); 429 detail message reworded to 'Daily limit reached (10/day). Resets at midnight UTC.' (server.py:223) — no longer mentions Upgrade/Premium.

AIToolRequest schema places target_language under `options` dict (server.py:72,557). Any frontend caller must send {tool, text, options:{target_language: ...}} — confirm /app/frontend code does this (settings/write screens).
Vocab script validator + single retry (server.py:706-739) confirmed working for Telugu/Tamil/Bengali via observed WARNING logs followed by passing assertions.
is_premium remains a real flag (admin-set only via whitelist). UI premium upsells/locks should be removed in frontend; this test pass does NOT verify frontend cleanup.
seed_data_creation: TestAdminWhitelist creates and deletes a single TEST_ whitelist entry inside the same test class. Two fresh guest accounts are created via /api/auth/guest and left in db.users (one used 10 free calls, one used 3 vocab calls) — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint for admin login is /api/auth/admin (NOT /admin/login). Vocab tool requires options.target_language (top-level target_language is silently ignored — defaults to English). FREE_TOOL_DAILY_LIMIT is 10 and 429 detail is exactly 'Daily limit reached (10/day). Resets at midnight UTC.'. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_no_premium_iter3.py -v`.
rca_of_issue: No production bug found. Initial 3 vocab failures were a test bug — I had sent target_language at the top level of the JSON body, but server reads it from `options.target_language`. Fixed the test payload and all 3 passed (script validator + retry confirmed working).
